decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of refuse or waste have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing of refuse or waste shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 4 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.
description: Change of use from Leisure (D2) to Restaurant (A3), addition of mezzanine floor and new shop front to unit.
